first_pass.original_student_trace_method:
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import tempfile

sys.path.insert(0, '/src/PROVERA')
from hdl_runtime import run
from simulacija import simulate
from systemverilog_check import vcd, compare

proof = []
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='de1-student-traces-') as td:
    for i, tb in enumerate(sorted(Path('/src').glob('[0-9][0-9]/code/**/tb_zadatak.vhd'))):
        work = Path(td) / str(i)
        work.mkdir()
        files = [p for p in sorted(tb.parent.glob('*.vhd')) if p.name not in ['zadatak.vhd','tb_zadatak.vhd']]
        files += [tb.parent / 'zadatak.vhd', tb]
        run(['ghdl','-a','--std=08',*map(str,files)],work)
        run(['ghdl','-e','--std=08','tb_zadatak'],work)
        run(['ghdl','-r','--std=08','tb_zadatak','--assert-level=error','--vcd=golden.vcd','--stop-time=1us'],work)
        simulate(tb.parent,'tb_zadatak',work,'iverilog')
        golden = {k.replace('tb_zadatak.', 'audit_tb.', 1):v for k,v in vcd(work/'golden.vcd').items()}
        actual = {k.replace('tb_zadatak.', 'audit_tb.', 1):v for k,v in vcd(work/'tb_zadatak.vcd').items()}
        end = min(max(t for seq in golden.values() for t,_ in seq),max(t for seq in actual.values() for t,_ in seq))
        start = 40*10**6 if 'parameter time T' in (tb.parent/'zadatak.sv').read_text() else 10**6
        names, count = compare(golden,actual,['uut'],start,end)
        proof.append(dict(path=str(tb.relative_to('/src')),signals=names,timepoints=count,result='pass'))
        print(str(tb.relative_to('/src')), 'original/SV student stimuli: pass',flush=True)
Path('/out/student_trace_equivalence.json').write_text(json.dumps(proof,indent=2)+'\n')

limitations: Verilator nije pun četvorovrednosni simulator; X/Z proverava Icarus.
Početno smirivanje je izuzeto; delta ciklusi porede se kroz konačnu vrednost pri istom fizičkom vremenu.
VHDL U mapira se u X; slabi STD_LOGIC nivoi nisu posebna SV stanja.
Vrednosti T u ovim primerima su celobrojni nanosekundni intervali.
PDF kopiranje celog listinga zahteva ActualText podršku; provereno Popplerom, ne clipboardom svakog GUI preglednika.
Za nepromenjenu teoriju sačuvana je prethodna evidencija uz ponovljene postojeće provere; pregled je izvršio Codex, bez novog ljudskog potpisa.
